    • configRefreshPeriod

      public B configRefreshPeriod(Duration duration)
      Sets the configuration refresh period for this instance. If not explicitly called, the default value will be SzAutoCoreEnvironment.DISABLED_CONFIG_REFRESH.

      See getConfigRefreshPeriod() for a description of how the specified duration relates to the configuration refresh modes.

      Parameters:
      duration - A positive Duration to enable Proactive configuration refresh, a zero (0) Duration to enable Reactive configuration refresh or null to Disable configuration refresh.
      Returns:
      A reference to this instance.
      Throws:

    • getConfigRefreshPeriod

      public Duration getConfigRefreshPeriod()
      Implemented to return the configuration refresh period, or null if none has been configured. Gets the configuration refresh period for this instance.

      Configuration refresh is the process by which the active configuration ID is compared to the current default configuration ID and if they are out of sync, the SzAutoCoreEnvironment is reinitialized with the current default configuration ID.

      Configuration refresh can be configured in one of three modes enumerated by SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RefreshMode.

      NOTE: Configuration refresh cannot be in any mode other than SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RefreshMode.DISABLED if the configuration ID is a non-null value. An exception will be thrown if attempting to construct an SzAutoCoreEnvironment with an explicit configuration ID with configuration refresh enabled.

      The possible values for this setting with their associated mode are as follows:

      • A null value implies that configuration refresh is disabled (see SzAutoCoreEnvironment.DISABLED_CONFIG_REFRESH).
      • A zero (0) Duration implies that configuration refresh will be reactive (see SzAutoCoreEnvironment.REACTIVE_CONFIG_REFRESH).
      • A positive Duration implies that configuration refresh will be proactive with the Duration value used as the refresh period.
      Specified by:
      getConfigRefreshPeriod in interface SzAutoCoreEnvironment.Initializer
      Returns:
      A positive Duration to enable proactive configuration refresh, a zero (0) Duration to enable reactive configuration refresh or null to disable configuration refresh.
      See Also:
      • SzAutoCoreEnvironment.DISABLED_CONFIG_REFRESH
      • SzAutoCoreEnvironment.REACTIVE_CONFIG_REFRESH

    • concurrency

      public B concurrency(Integer concurrency) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Sets the concurrency for the thread pool used to execute the Senzing Core SDK operations. If not explicitly called, the default value will be SzAutoCoreEnvironment.DISABLED_CONCURRENCY.

      See getConcurrency() for a description of how the specified concurrency affects the thread pool and how it is used.

      Parameters:
      concurrency - A positive integer indicating the size of the thread pool, zero (0) to use the a number of threads equal to Runtime.availableProcessors(), or null to disable the thread pool.
      Returns:
      A reference to this instance.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If a negative value is specified.
      See Also:

      • SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RECOMMENDED_CONCURRENCY

    • getConcurrency

      public Integer getConcurrency()
      Implemented to return the concurrency or null if none has been configured. Gets the concurrency for the thread pool used to execute the Senzing Core SDK operations.

      The Senzing Core SDK allocates resources that are local to each thread. These resources are allocated when first needed and then cached per thread to enhance performance of subsequent Core SDK operations performed on that thread. As such, it is best to reuse the same threads each time for the Core SDK operations both for performance reasons and to prevent excessive memory allocation.

      Server applications that leverage the Senzing Core SDK may have a large number of threads for servicing requests, but should limit the concurrency for the Senzing Core SDK to at most the number of processing cores on the machine (or less if memory is limited).

      The provided value determines the behavior:
      • If null (see SzAutoCoreEnvironment.DISABLED_CONCURRENCY) then the thread pool is disabled and all operations are performed in the calling thread. This may be desirable if you have an ExecutorService that you are already using to perform one more Senzing Core SDK operations in conjunction and you want to avoid unnecessary context switching.
      • If zero (0) (see SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RECOMMENDED_CONCURRENCY) then the thread pool will be enabled with a number of threads equal to the number of processing cores as determined by Runtime.availableProcessors().
      • If a positive integer then the thread pool will be enabled using that number of threads.

      Any created thread pool will be disposed upon calling SzCoreEnvironment.destroy().

      Specified by:
      getConcurrency in interface SzAutoCoreEnvironment.Initializer
      Returns:
      A positive integer indicating the size of the thread pool, zero (0) to use the number of threads equal to Runtime.availableProcessors(), or null to disable the thread pool.
      See Also:
      • SzAutoCoreEnvironment.DISABLED_CONCURRENCY
      • SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RECOMMENDED_CONCURRENCY

    • maxBasicRetries

      public B maxBasicRetries(int maxRetries) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Sets the maximum number of basic retries to perform when an SzRetryableException is encountered when invoking an Senzing Core SDK operation.

      See getMaxBasicRetries() for a description of how the maximum is applied.

      Parameters:

    • getMaxBasicRetries

      public int getMaxBasicRetries()
      Implemented to return the configuration refresh period, or null if none has been configured. Returns the maximum number of times a method invocation should be retried either due to an SzRetryableException being encountered.

      There are several things to note:

      1. This setting has no effect on the retrying of Senzing Core SDK methods annotated with SzConfigRetryable methods as that is simply governed by the active configuration requiring a refresh.
      2. Each subsequent retry for will occur after increasingly long delay to allow the condition causing the failure to be resolved.
      3. Since the basic retries are nested with the configuration refresh retries, it is possible, though unlikely, for the total number of retries to exceed the maximum. For example, a method may fail due to a missing data source in the active configuration, triggering a retry after the configuration refresh, and the retried attempt may then fail due to a persistent deadlock condition causing multiple SzRetryableException's being thrown.
      Specified by:
      getMaxBasicRetries in interface SzAutoCoreEnvironment.Initializer
      Returns:
      The maximum number of times to retry a method invocation due to an SzRetryableException.
